SYMPTOM: `claude -p` hangs ~70 seconds when called from pixel office server or manually. `time PIXEL_OFFICE_HAIKU=1 claude -p 'say hi' --model haiku --max-turns 1 -d` → 70s, 9% CPU (waiting, not compute).

CAUSE 1 (recursion): Spawning `claude -p` from the server's execFile triggers UserPromptSubmit hook → POSTs to server → server spawns another claude -p → infinite loop.
FIX: Added `PIXEL_OFFICE_HAIKU=1` env var to all pixel office hook scripts as a guard. When set, hooks skip curl to server. Set this env in execFile call.

CAUSE 2 (slow): Even with PIXEL_OFFICE_HAIKU=1, -p takes ~70s. Low CPU means it's waiting. Likely non-pixel-office hooks (memory curation at localhost:8765, session persistence) timing out slowly.
FIX: Not yet resolved — need to identify which hooks are timing out with debug output (`-d` flag) or by disabling non-pixel-office hooks temporarily.

PREVENT: Check all global hooks for slow external calls. Any hook hitting an offline service blocks ALL claude -p invocations.
